about: Risperdal covers the episode of symptomatic high prolactin, the review records relapse with both reduction and switching, and the dispensing rows show no aripiprazole supply during the episode.

Possible finding: the record holds no line about hyperprolactinaemia or prolactin. Solian (amisulpride, an antipsychotic that raises prolactin) is supplied every month and no aripiprazole is supplied.
Oral aripiprazole began on 3 February for symptomatic high prolactin, the repeat samples were taken on 6 and 10 February, and the latter was normal with documented resolution.
